feeRows.label: Initiation Fee
feeRows.note: Paid at time of joining. Non-refundable.

feeRows.label: Individual Dues
feeRows.note: Prorated in your first calendar year.

feeRows.label: Background Check
feeRows.note: Waived if you present an unexpired Texas License to Carry.

feeRows.label: Spouse Add-On
feeRows.note: Individual plan only. Spouse must meet all primary member requirements.

feeRows.label: Junior Add-On
feeRows.note: Individual plan; included in Family plan.

feeRows.label: Work Day Non-Completion Fee
feeRows.note: Added if 3 volunteer Work Days not completed within first year.

addons.label: Spouse (Individual Plan)
addons.desc: Must independently meet all primary member requirements.

addons.label: Junior
addons.desc: Children or grandchildren aged 21 or under. Included in Family plan.

addons.label: Match Participation
addons.desc: Range use during club-hosted matches is open to non-members.

notes.title: Annual Renewal Required
notes.body: All members — including Life Members — must renew every year. Renewal notices go out in early October. Lapsed 2+ years? You must rejoin as a new member.

notes.title: Prorated First Year
notes.body: New member dues are prorated depending on the month you join. Do not bring exact payment to orientation unless you know the prorated amount.

notes.title: Volunteer Requirement
notes.body: New and returning members must complete 3 Work Days (2nd Saturday of each month, 8am–12pm) within the first year to achieve full voting membership.

notes.title: Family ≠ Extended Family
notes.body: The Family plan covers a married couple and their children/grandchildren (≤21). Siblings, parents, and extended family are not included.
